notes.title: April 9, 2022 - Steam Playtest update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41995663/ed37c837599fd8ff31d613921b48b90a7bc2d5b9.jpg
Hello Hunters,

Thank you for taking part in Carnivores: Dinosaur Hunt Playtest. 
Today, we'vereleased new update to the game which includes number of changes and bug-fixes based on your feedback as well as our internal QA process.

You can find all issues fixed based on community feedback as marked with [strike]strike font[/strike] from this list:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1806660/discussions/1/3192493375700623187/

Please make sure to update Carnivores: Dinosaur Hunt Playtest to the latest version and keep sharing your experience and feedback in this community.


Thank you, and good hunting,
DDE Team
